source: English Wikipedia MediaWiki API recentchanges, main namespace, edit events, non-bot filter
selection_rule: one latest observed edit event per page in the downloaded response; sort by pageid; seeded sample without replacement
semantic_predicates: The main subject is a living person.
The main subject is an organization.
The document describes an event that has already occurred.
The document describes a planned or future event.
The document states that the main subject currently holds an official position.
query_fanout_rule: 1 + first eight bytes of SHA-256(pageid) modulo 8
primary_metrics: fraction of version-predicate pairs whose fixed-model label changes
fraction of page pairs with at least one label change
reuse filter error across the sampled page population
full-recompute calls divided by observed changed-label calls
scientific_boundaries: This is a small recent-edit pilot, not a population estimate for all document systems.
The model sees the first 768 tokens of raw wikitext after light cleaning.
Model transitions are not human semantic truth.
Recent edits may include vandalism and reverts even after excluding bot edits.
The sample is frozen before revision contents and model labels are read.
